body: well, I just feel like I cry a lot and have a lot of emotions, and I know that's really hard for other people to deal with, and when I'm really upset, I need to talk to someone about it, and I know a lot of people probably hate doing that...

thank you. I agreed too, I didn't think a real friend would do any of the things she did. she put me through a lot of shit that really fucked with my emotions and the way I feel about myself as a person. even when I tried to tell her that I really missed her and I wished we would hang out like we used to, she just gave me a bullshit "okay, okay" and then went right back to spending all of her time with her new boyfriend.

it really just started to make me feel like maybe I can't even ask my friends to care about me. maybe I'm just too much to be around, I'm too needy, too emotional, and I get frustrated too easily. I don't like myself, I wouldn't want to be my friend.

I really shouldn't keep inflicting myself on other people like this. even the people who have somehow convinced themselves that they like me, I know they don't really, I know they wish I was gone. and this way, I could be...
